confirmed.title: refund() writes a status outside the system
confirmed.label: INCONSISTENCY
confirmed.root_cause: refund assigns the literal 'refund_pending', which STATUS does not declare

impact.demonstrated: A refunded order holds a status no operation reads, exits or archives
impact.not_verified: How often this happens in production and its external cost are not established by the module alone

confidence.basis: Direct source evidence plus a concrete trace through the operator

confirmed.recommendation: Declare refund_pending with its exits, or route refunds through a declared state

confirmed.title: in_review is declared but nothing produces it
confirmed.label: INCONSISTENCY
confirmed.root_cause: No operator writes in_review; mark_paid skips the anti-fraud state

impact.demonstrated: Every payment bypasses the declared anti-fraud review
impact.not_verified: How often this happens in production and its external cost are not established by the module alone

confidence.basis: Direct source evidence plus a concrete trace through the operator

confirmed.recommendation: Add the operator that moves pending_payment to in_review and make mark_paid require it

confirmed.title: Operators change status without checking the current state
confirmed.label: INCONSISTENCY
confirmed.root_cause: Only deliver guards its source state; every other status write ignores the current state

impact.demonstrated: cancel turns a shipped order into canceled, which the README forbids
impact.not_verified: How often this happens in production and its external cost are not established by the module alone

confidence.basis: Direct source evidence plus a concrete trace through the operator

confirmed.recommendation: Introduce a single transition function with a declared transition table

confirmed.title: Paused orders can never resume
confirmed.label: INCONSISTENCY
confirmed.root_cause: hold has no inverse operator that restores held_from

impact.demonstrated: An order put on hold stays on_hold permanently
impact.not_verified: How often this happens in production and its external cost are not established by the module alone

confidence.basis: Direct source evidence plus a concrete trace through the operator

confirmed.recommendation: Add resume() that restores held_from and clears it

confirmed.title: The discount unit depends on the value
confirmed.label: AMBIGUITY
confirmed.root_cause: apply_discount switches between fraction and amount at value 1, contradicting the percentage rule
confirmed.question: Is a discount a percentage 0-100, a fraction 0-1, or a fixed amount, and what does 1 mean?

impact.demonstrated: A discount of 1 removes the whole total while 2 subtracts two currency units
impact.not_verified: How often this happens in production and its external cost are not established by the module alone

confidence.basis: Direct source evidence plus a concrete trace through the operator

confirmed.recommendation: Decide the unit, accept only that unit, and validate the range

confirmed.title: The stored total drifts from the items
confirmed.label: INCONSISTENCY
confirmed.root_cause: total is materialized and also derivable from items, and writers update only one side

evidence.quote: return sum(i.qty * i.price for i in order.items)

impact.demonstrated: Adding an item after checkout leaves total lower than the sum of the items
impact.not_verified: How often this happens in production and its external cost are not established by the module alone

confidence.basis: Direct source evidence plus a concrete trace through the operator

confirmed.recommendation: Derive the total from items and store the discount separately

confirmed.title: A retried payment webhook is counted twice
confirmed.label: RISK
confirmed.root_cause: The handler appends and adds the amount without checking the event id
confirmed.condition: The provider retries the same event id after a timeout or a non-200 response, as the README says it does

impact.demonstrated: Delivering the same event twice doubles total_paid
impact.not_verified: How often the provider retries in production

confidence.basis: Direct source evidence plus a concrete trace through the operator

confirmed.recommendation: Ignore events whose id is already recorded before changing totals

confirmed.title: A courier failure leaves inventory reserved
confirmed.label: RISK
confirmed.root_cause: ship performs two side effects without a transaction or compensation
confirmed.condition: courier.notify raises after inventory.reserve has succeeded

impact.demonstrated: If courier.notify raises, inventory stays reserved and the order is not shipped
impact.not_verified: How often this happens in production and its external cost are not established by the module alone

confidence.basis: Direct source evidence plus a concrete trace through the operator

confirmed.recommendation: Reserve and notify atomically, or release the reservation when notify fails

rejected.reason: deliver raises unless the order is shipped, so delivered is only written from shipped
